title: 雪山隧道工程~Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering
focus: 破碎帶水壓、長距離探勘與雙孔道路防災~Fault-zone water pressure, long-distance investigation and twin-bore road resilience
summary: 雪山隧道穿越台灣北部山區，連接北宜高速公路，高公局公開資料列長約12.9公里。本進階課由破碎帶水力連通開始，追蹤開挖、支護及排水的交互作用，再把量測基準和設備資料交給營運端；重點是辨識未知條件如何改變結論，而不重複隧道的入門介紹。~The approximately 12.9 km Hsuehshan Tunnel connects the northern Taiwan expressway with Yilan through mountainous terrain. This advanced course follows fault-zone hydraulic connectivity through excavation, support and drainage, then transfers survey baselines and equipment evidence to operations. Its emphasis is how uncertain conditions change engineering conclusions rather than repeating an introductory description of the tunnel.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 將雪山山區破碎帶視為多條可能連通水路，研究先進孔揭露的新裂隙如何修正主孔前方預測；不能以已排出的水量推定剩餘岩體必然乾燥。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Treat the mountain fault zone as several potentially connected pathways and examine how a newly intercepted fracture changes the forecast ahead of the main bore. Water already drained does not prove the remaining ground is dry. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2 無因次；通水面積=200 m²。Q=k i A=0.0004 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00044 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2 dimensionless; flow area=200 m². Q=k i A=0.0004 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00044 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 若抽水後短暫衰減被誤判為水源耗盡，進入另一連通裂隙時水量可能回升；應用壓力回復試驗區分補注。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~A temporary decline mistaken for exhaustion can be followed by renewed inflow from another fracture; pressure recovery helps distinguish recharge. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 以雪山兩孔及探勘坑之間的水頭差建立假想分層模型，分辨局部排水效果與整座山體地下水位下降；永久襯砌還要承受排水失效狀態。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Build a hypothetical layered head model between the two bores and exploratory gallery, separating local drainage from regional drawdown. Permanent lining must also be assessed when the drainage path is unavailable. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為334.521 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 334.521 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 一孔排水可能讓另一孔水位同步變化，若當作兩次獨立事件會誤估滲透性；需先查共同補注和管路連通。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Drainage in one bore may alter the other; treating these as independent events biases permeability estimates, so investigate shared recharge and connections. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 將雪山覆土與破碎帶交界分開，檢查高應力岩塊旁的低剛度帶是否使洞壁變形集中；覆土相近的兩個斷面不一定採相同材料模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~Separate cover effects from the fault transition and examine whether a compliant band beside stressed blocks concentrates wall movement. Two sections with similar cover need not share the same constitutive model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=500 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.9 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=500 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.9 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 若只按平均岩級分段，局部剝落與擠壓可被混為同一機制，導致支護剛度增加卻無法容納位移。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~Averaged ground classes can confuse spalling with squeezing, increasing stiffness without providing the needed displacement capacity. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 以雪山長隧道施工的支護封閉時序為題，分析掌子面前進後尚未形成閉合環的暫時狀態；開挖面距離與支護齡期要與最終尺寸同時保留。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Study the temporary condition before support closes into a ring as the heading advances. Face distance and support age must remain visible alongside final dimensions when interpreting loads and convergence. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=30 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=240 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為264 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=30 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=240 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 264 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Mark each closure time on convergence histories and test whether rate changes coincide with construction events and corresponding support-load changes. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 位移趨緩可能只是量測點移出活躍區，若未記錄掌子面位置會過早認定整段已穩定。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Slower movement may mean the point has left the active zone; without face position it can be misread as stability of the whole section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Mark each closure time on convergence histories and test whether rate changes coincide with construction events and corresponding support-load changes. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 雪山案例用來比較受地質限制的掘進循環：刀具切削時間、檢查修理及出渣等待必須分開，才能判定設備瓶頸或破碎帶風險誰先控制進度。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Use the Hsuehshan context to separate cutting, inspection and spoil queues in a geologically constrained cycle, determining whether machinery or fault-zone uncertainty controls progress before proposing a production change. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.5 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。D=24vu=11.16 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.276 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.5 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.16 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.276 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把停機原因碼對齊刀具檢查和地質里程，另以完整班次的時間收支核對日報，避免只選高產時段評估機器。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align downtime causes with cutter inspection and geological chainage, checking a complete shift time balance rather than selecting high-output intervals. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 出渣等待若被列為地質停工，會把後勤問題誤判成岩石太硬，導致無效更換刀具或修改推進策略。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~Spoil queues classified as ground delay falsely suggest hard rock and prompt ineffective cutter replacement or advance changes. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：把停機原因碼對齊刀具檢查和地質里程，另以完整班次的時間收支核對日報，避免只選高產時段評估機器。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Align downtime causes with cutter inspection and geological chainage, checking a complete shift time balance rather than selecting high-output intervals. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 雪山山區工址的長距離運輸使裝載、交會與卸料相互制約，假想多工作面同時出渣時需檢查共同通道容量，不能只按各面最佳日進尺配置車隊。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Long access distances couple loading, passing and unloading. For simultaneous hypothetical headings, test the shared route against combined demand rather than sizing fleets from each face best daily advance. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=20 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為124.675 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=20 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 124.675 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按車次配對裝載重量和到卸料點時間，找出排隊集中區；比較維修期間與正常時段的有效循環。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair payloads with arrival times at unloading, locate queue concentration and compare effective cycles during maintenance and ordinary service. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 增加車輛若堵住單線交會點，總運量反而下降，且材料補給可能與撤離需求競爭同一空間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~More vehicles can block passing locations and reduce throughput while material deliveries compete with evacuation access. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：按車次配對裝載重量和到卸料點時間，找出排隊集中區；比較維修期間與正常時段的有效循環。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Pair payloads with arrival times at unloading, locate queue concentration and compare effective cycles during maintenance and ordinary service. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 雪山長距離貫通的教學情境著重方向傳遞：將洞口地表基準、導坑及主孔控制網分開覆核，找出共用基準偏差無法靠重複量測自行消除的原因。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~For long-distance breakthrough, independently examine surface control, pilot-gallery transfer and the main-bore network. Identify why repeated measurements cannot remove a bias inherited from a shared starting datum. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3000 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.041597 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=3000 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.041597 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 若把導坑成果當絕對真值，主孔與導坑可以共同偏離正確方向，兩者彼此吻合仍會錯過預定貫通位置。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Treating pilot control as exact can make both networks agree while both deviate from the intended breakthrough point. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 以雪山雙孔道路的一孔維修為情境，分析風門、橫通道及車流邊界如何共同改變網路；不能把施工通風模型直接移作營運控煙模型。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Use maintenance in one road bore to examine changes in dampers, passages and traffic boundaries. Construction ventilation cannot be transferred directly into an operational smoke-control model with different occupants and sources. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=500 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=25.6688 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為31.0592 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=500 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=25.6688 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 31.0592 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步記錄兩孔風速、壓差與門位，先比正常工況再比核准異常工況，辨認風量減少來自漏風還是阻力增加。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 橫通道門位資料若過期，模型可能預測隔離但現場形成短路風流，關鍵區段抽排效果便被高估。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Outdated passage-door states may predict isolation while a real airflow shortcut reduces extraction in the critical zone. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步記錄兩孔風速、壓差與門位，先比正常工況再比核准異常工況，辨認風量減少來自漏風還是阻力增加。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.anchor: 剩餘集水容積~Remaining sump volume
units.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積~Outage buffer and effective sump volume
units.mechanism: 雪山排水教學把斷層入流和機電故障合併：若雨後淨入流提高同時一台泵維修，剩餘容積與警報延遲要放在同一時間線，不把名義備援當保證。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。~Combine fault inflow and equipment state: after rainfall, increased net inflow can coincide with pump maintenance. Place usable volume and alarm delay on one timeline rather than treating nominal redundancy as guaranteed service. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=300 m³；淨入流=0.2 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=25 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.7273 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=300 m³; net inflow=0.2 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=25 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.7273 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用實測集水坑水位容積曲線核對流量，再將維修隔離狀態和警報傳輸延遲加入緩衝計算，確認淤積已扣除。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check flow against the measured sump curve, then include isolated equipment and alarm-transmission delay in the buffer calculation with sediment deducted. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 若雨後水量超過平日平均而沿用舊緩衝時間，故障處理可能尚未完成水位已達設備區，形成連鎖失效。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。~Using an ordinary-day buffer after rainfall can let water reach equipment before recovery is complete, producing cascading failure. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.
units.misconception: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。~Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：用實測集水坑水位容積曲線核對流量，再將維修隔離狀態和警報傳輸延遲加入緩衝計算，確認淤積已扣除。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Check flow against the measured sump curve, then include isolated equipment and alarm-transmission delay in the buffer calculation with sediment deducted. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 雪山營運交接以排水及通風共同介面為核心，要求一項告警能追到設備位置、供電來源和最後校正；改名或設備更換不能切斷原始趨勢。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Handover focuses on drainage-ventilation interfaces: each alarm must trace to location, supply and last calibration. Renaming or replacement must preserve the ability to interpret historical trends and distinguish renewal from deterioration. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=100 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.4 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=100 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.4 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查低點水位告警與風機故障各一例，從控制畫面找到工單及現場標籤，重算設備更換前後是否可直接比較。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample a low-point alarm and fan fault from screen to work order and physical tag, testing comparability across equipment replacement. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 若新水位計沿用舊零點卻換了安裝高程，趨勢可能顯示假的水量增加；先核對基準而非立刻擴泵。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~A replacement level sensor at a new elevation with an old zero creates false rising-water trends; check datum before increasing pumping. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查低點水位告警與風機故障各一例，從控制畫面找到工單及現場標籤，重算設備更換前後是否可直接比較。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample a low-point alarm and fan fault from screen to work order and physical tag, testing comparability across equipment replacement. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為334.521 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=20 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為124.675 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate piezometric head and lining pressure, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 334.521 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=20 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 124.675 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2006 年公開記錄：雪山隧道開始小型車通行，之後分階段開放大客車。雪山隧道穿越台灣北部山區，連接北宜高速公路，高公局公開資料列長約12.9公里。本進階課由破碎帶水力連通開始，追蹤開挖、支護及排水的交互作用，再把量測基準和設備資料交給營運端；重點是辨識未知條件如何改變結論，而不重複隧道的入門介紹。本課把「破碎帶水壓、長距離探勘與雙孔道路防災」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2006: Hsuehshan Tunnel opens to small vehicles before a later staged opening to coaches. The approximately 12.9 km Hsuehshan Tunnel connects the northern Taiwan expressway with Yilan through mountainous terrain. This advanced course follows fault-zone hydraulic connectivity through excavation, support and drainage, then transfers survey baselines and equipment evidence to operations. Its emphasis is how uncertain conditions change engineering conclusions rather than repeating an introductory description of the tunnel. The course treats fault-zone water pressure, long-distance investigation and twin-bore road resilience as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 12.9 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 12.9 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2006 年事件：雪山隧道開始小型車通行，之後分階段開放大客車。~2006 event: Hsuehshan Tunnel opens to small vehicles before a later staged opening to coaches.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.0004 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=1e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.0004 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.
